rules.description: BMC PATROL system-mode CPU-time percentage field
provenance: Exact BMC PATROL parameter name CPUSysTime; official documentation describes percentage of CPU time in system mode (0-100). OpenRCA input does not pin the BMC producer/version or transforms.

rules.description: BMC PATROL user-mode CPU-time percentage field
provenance: Exact BMC PATROL parameter name CPUUserTime; official documentation describes percentage of CPU time in user mode (0-100). OpenRCA input does not pin the BMC producer/version or transforms.

rules.description: BMC PATROL disk-busy percentage across exact disk instances
provenance: Exact BMC PATROL DSKPercentBusy parameter family; BMC catalogs this as a disk-busy percentage parameter. OpenRCA input does not pin producer/version or transforms.
Exact Redis INFO key used_memory; Redis allocator bytes currently allocated. OpenRCA input does not pin Redis exporter/version or transforms.
Exact Redis INFO key used_memory_rss; Redis resident-set bytes. OpenRCA input does not pin Redis exporter/version or transforms.
Exact Redis INFO key mem_fragmentation_ratio; Redis RSS/used-memory ratio; documentation warns it also includes other overhead. OpenRCA input does not pin Redis exporter/version or transforms.
Exact Redis INFO key instantaneous_ops_per_sec; Redis instantaneous command rate. OpenRCA input does not pin Redis exporter/version or transforms.
Exact Redis INFO key instantaneous_input_kbps; Redis documents instantaneous network input throughput in kilobytes per second. OpenRCA input does not pin Redis exporter/version or transforms.
Exact Redis INFO key instantaneous_output_kbps; Redis documents instantaneous network output throughput in kilobytes per second. OpenRCA input does not pin Redis exporter/version or transforms.
Exact Redis INFO key blocked_clients; current clients blocked on blocking calls. OpenRCA input does not pin Redis exporter/version or transforms.
Exact Redis INFO key connected_clients; current client connections excluding replicas. OpenRCA input does not pin Redis exporter/version or transforms.
Exact Redis INFO key connected_slaves; current connected replicas. OpenRCA input does not pin Redis exporter/version or transforms.
Exact Redis INFO key pubsub_channels; current subscribed pub/sub channel count. OpenRCA input does not pin Redis exporter/version or transforms.

rules.description: BMC PATROL filesystem used-capacity percentage across instances
provenance: BMC PATROL defines FSCapacity as percentage of filesystem space in use (0-100). The public Bank source does not pin collector version or value transformation.

rules.description: BMC PATROL filesystem inode-used percentage across instances
provenance: BMC maps the filesystem InodeUsedPercent attribute to FSInodeUsedPercent and documents the used-inode percentage. The public Bank source does not pin collector version or value transformation.

rules.description: BMC PATROL filesystem available-space gauge across instances
provenance: BMC maps filesystem AvailableSpace to FSAvailableSpace and describes the amount of filesystem space available; units vary by collector/platform. The public Bank source does not pin that mapping.

rules.description: BMC PATROL filesystem used-space gauge across instances
provenance: BMC maps filesystem UsedSpace to FSUsedSpace and describes current used storage; units vary by collector/platform. The public Bank source does not pin that mapping. Same-field within-instance comparison only.

rules.description: BMC PATROL network output-error percentage candidate
provenance: BMC PATROL maps network OutgoingErrors to NETOutErrPrc. Its name indicates a percentage-like gauge, but the public Bank input does not pin the collector's denominator or mapping. It is not request latency.

log_service.derived_unit: record rows per fixed one-minute case-relative bucket; empty buckets are zero rows recorded in the supplied clip
log_service.raw_value_interpretation: not parsed; original clipped CSV remains hash-pinned

log_pattern_exposure_rate.unit: fraction of full-window source log rows
provenance: Derived composition/exposure measure over trusted complete full-window log row denominator; descriptive pattern fraction only, not an error or request-failure rate.
